messages:
Nina (Growth): Quick catch-up on SEO tasks for the launch week: webinar page, launch post, and partner redirect mapping. Need schema, short FAQ, internal anchors, and the redirect doc by EOD Tue.
Omar: For keywords I ran a quick cluster:
- 'scalable LLM serving'
- 'low latency LLM deployment'
- 'inference cost per token'
- 'on-prem model serving'
- 'LLM serving observability'
Priya: Nice set. Can we prioritize 2 primary + 3 longtails? Id use the longtails in CTAs and blog headings.
Nina (Growth): Primary: 'scalable LLM serving' and 'inference cost per token'. Longtails as supporting.
seo-bot: Audit note: 7 pages missing schema.org markup on event or article. See report: https://internal/seo/2165004319 (auto)
Priya: For the webinar reg page we should include Event JSON-LD + FAQPage for the registration flow. Posting a minimal example: 
```
<script type="application/ld+json">{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Production Benchmarks",
  "startDate": "2026-05-10T17:00:00Z",
  "location": {
    "@type": "VirtualLocation",
    "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar/register/beta"
  },
  "description": "Live demo and benchmark narrative: predictable latency and cost controls for LLM inference."
}
</script>
```
Omar: FAQ suggestions (3):
1) What latency can we expect? Answer: median p95 numbers from the perf deck with caveats.
2) Can I run privately? Answer: yes, VPC/private deployment available.
3) How is billing calculated? Answer: per-token + model variant multiplier.
Nina (Growth): Also include breadcrumbs for the blog post and link to the webinar reg page.
engops-bot: Heads-up: Redirect deploy window Tue 22:00-23:00 UTC. Please submit PRs 2 hrs before.
Omar: Redirect examples for ops team: 
```
# netlify/_redirects style
/old-partner-signup  /webinar/register/beta  301!  
/blog/legacy-launch  /blog/2026/launch  301
```
Priya: I'll run an internal-link check using Linkinator and export anchors: `npx linkinator https://staging.redwood.ai --format json > anchors.json`
seo-bot: Suggestion: canonicalize partner landing pages to avoid duplicate content. Marked 3 candidates in the sheet.
Nina (Growth): Assignments: Omar -> final keyword boarding + hero variants by Mon noon. Priya -> JSON-LD + FAQ draft by Mon EOD. EngOps -> redirect PRs by Tue 20:00 UTC. Ryan (runtime) -> verify latency claims by Tue.
Omar: I'll A/B test H1 copy: 'Scalable LLM serving' vs 'Production-grade model inference'.
Priya: Pasting micro-FAQ copy for quick QA: 
Q: What uptime SLA do you offer? A: See enterprise page; for hosted we aim for 99.9% for API endpoints.
Nina (Growth): Good. Tagging @Ryan to check SLA/latency wording.
engops-bot: Reminder: include UTM params on redirect targets, example: `?utm_source=redwood_partners&utm_medium=redirect&utm_campaign=webinar_may`.
seo-bot: Crawl summary: crawler found 4 orphaned content pages — likely candidates to link from the launch post. Report: https://internal/seo/orphans/2165004320
Nina (Growth): Great. We'll meet Tue morning if any blockers. Drop quick updates here. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
